command: set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state >/dev/null; STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo call_state=$STATE; test "$STATE" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -n pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.MainActivity --ez run_shizuku_live_probe true --ei shizuku_live_duration_ms 1000 >/dev/null; sleep 6; OUT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief | grep -E 'AiCallBridge.*(shizuku_live_probe_result|probe=|error=|service_uid=|prepared_|active_|heartbeat_|live_parity_ok=)' | tail -n 120 || true); printf '%s\n' "$OUT"; printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'probe=shizuku-user-service-live-v1'; printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'error='; printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -Eq 'not in call|not_in_call|MODE_IN_CALL|telephony'; if printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'live_parity_ok=true'; then exit 41; fi; echo phase2c_live_trigger_offcall_guard_ok=true
